'''Threco''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Quartermaster/Legends|supply officer]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He sold various [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="The Old Republic" />
